Based on searching Instagram hashtags related to Toronto travel, I would recommend visiting: 

- CN Tower - this famous landmark is featured under #cntower and #torontotravel 

- Ripley's Aquarium of Canada - popular hashtag #ripleysaquariumtoronto

- St. Lawrence Market - seen under #stlawrencemarket and #torontomarket 

- High Park - this large park shows up under #highpark and #cherryblossoms

- Kensington Market - featured using #kensingtonmarket hashtag

- Distillery District - popular hashtag #distilleryTO

I hope these popular Toronto locations give you some good ideas for your family trip! Let me know if you need any other recommendations. Enjoy your time in Toronto!
